paper.title: Optimizing Database System Performance: Design and Query Optimization Strategies
paper.venue: AIUB Journal of Science and Engineering (AJSE)

summary.text: A study of relational database design and query optimisation for practitioners. It evaluates different relational models against varying data volumes, analysing query cost with a cost-based optimizer and access-time measurements. The conclusions are practical guidance for database administrators: separate entities by specialised usage, and take account of record count, attribute size, query type, key usage, order-by clauses and index sequences when structuring queries.
summary.relationship_to_sqlancer: A database performance study, not a testing paper; its connection to SQLancer is only the citation recorded in the citation graph.
supporting_excerpts: This research evaluates different relational database models using varying amounts of data.
Query costs are analyzed using the Cost-Based Optimizer method and access time measurements.

sources.note: Semantic Scholar records this paper as citing the publication that introduced Cardinality Estimation Restriction Testing (CERT).
